discription: A detuned saw wave synth with a classic ADSR envelope, creating a rich, full sound.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, detune=0.005; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.2, 0.7, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = (Saw.ar(freq) + Saw.ar(freq * (1 + detune))) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
